cafc-wallet.title: Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre bulletin: Cryptocurrency wallet fraud (via FCNB)
cafc-wallet.supports: Never share a recovery phrase; legitimate support never asks for it; unsolicited contact, 'verify/connect your wallet' links, remote-access requests and 'move to this wallet' are warning signs.

ftc-crypto.title: FTC: What To Know About Cryptocurrency and Scams
ftc-crypto.supports: Scammers impersonate companies; don't click links in unexpected messages; only scammers demand crypto; free-crypto giveaways are fake.

ftc-phishing.title: FTC: How To Recognize and Avoid Phishing Scams
ftc-phishing.supports: Urgency and links are signs; contact companies through a site or app you know is real; real companies won't send a link asking you to update details.

ftc-impersonator.title: FTC: What To Know About Cryptocurrency and Scams
ftc-impersonator.supports: Legitimate businesses never message you on social media demanding money or crypto.

ftc-tech-support.title: Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre bulletin: Cryptocurrency wallet fraud (via FCNB)
ftc-tech-support.supports: Requests to install software or give remote access are warning signs.

ftc-family.title: FTC: Family emergency scams (advice and alerts)
ftc-family.supports: Check with the family member on a number you already know before sending money.

ftc-jobs.title: FTC: Task scams create the illusion of making money
ftc-jobs.supports: Real jobs never make you pay to start earning.

europol-report.title: Europol: Report cybercrime online (links to each EU country's reporting site)
europol-report.supports: Europe: report online fraud through your country's official police reporting site, listed by Europol; where there is no online option, go to the local police.

ic3-2024.title: FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center: 2024 Internet Crime Report (summary)
ic3-2024.supports: Investment fraud was the largest loss category ($6.57B); crypto investment fraud $5.8B; crypto-related losses $9.32B.

ftc-data-2024.title: FTC: New data show a big jump in reported losses to fraud (2024)
ftc-data-2024.supports: Investment scams: highest losses ($5.7B). Imposter scams: most reported. Job scam losses and reports rising sharply.

chainalysis-2025.title: Chainalysis 2025 Crypto Crime Report: scams (summary)
chainalysis-2025.supports: Relationship-investment ('pig butchering') scams led crypto scam revenue in 2024, up 40%.
